verdict.rationale: The only offline-related evidence is a help-center heading, "Using Shopify POS offline". It does not say that card payments can be taken offline or that transactions are stored and forwarded when connectivity returns. Separately, the Tap to Pay page says WiFi and cellular connectivity let you take contactless payments, which points to a connectivity requirement. "Offline and online orders in sync" refers to in-store versus online sales channels, not internet outages.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns
